## What changed

Describe the user-visible or internal change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or no behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed

## Security and data review

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or private endpoints are included
- [ ] New or changed inputs are validated at their trust boundary
- [ ] Dependency and lockfile changes were reviewed for vulnerabilities, licenses, and install scripts
- [ ] Workflow changes use least privilege, immutable action SHAs, and no untrusted shell interpolation
- [ ] Persistence or migration changes preserve existing projects and include recovery tests

## Compatibility and risk

- Breaking changes: none, or describe them here
- Security implications: none, or describe the affected trust boundary and mitigation

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visible UI changes when practical.
